title: AFNI Synthesize

TR.desc: TR to set in the output.  The default value of TR is read from the header of the matrix file.

cbucket.desc: Read the dataset output from 3dDeconvolve via the '-cbucket' option.

cenfill.desc: Determines how censored time points from the 3dDeconvolve run will be filled. Valid types are 'zero', 'nbhr' and 'none'.

dry_run.desc: Don't compute the output, just check the inputs.

matrix.desc: Read the matrix output from 3dDeconvolve via the '-x1D' option.

select.desc: A list of selected columns from the matrix (and the corresponding coefficient sub-bricks from the cbucket). Valid types include 'baseline',  'polort', 'allfunc', 'allstim', 'all', Can also provide 'something' where something matches a stim_label from 3dDeconvolve, and 'digits' where digits are the numbers of the select matrix columns by numbers (starting at 0), or number ranges of the form '3..7' and '3-7'.

description: Reads a '-cbucket' dataset and a '.xmat.1D' matrix from 3dDeconvolve,
